BiblicalUsage: Talmon was a porter, a temple doorkeeper, and the sons of Talmon were among the porters who returned from exile. The Chronicler names Talmon among the chief porters at the gates of the house of the Lord, and Nehemiah settles his sons at the gates of Jerusalem. The name is carried by a family of keepers, not by a single story.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the doorkeepers are honoured in the lists because the gates matter: someone must watch them, and Talmon's sons did, from the return to the days of Nehemiah.
